🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: mixed sector participation (7/11) and concentrated short-term leadership (Tech 3/5 in top performers) produce a neutral read; major large-cap divergences (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL showing 1W vs 1M splits) are a second confirmation. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary lead: AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND; BKNG (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities and Real Estate lag: VST (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND; VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION. Industrials soft: CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY; ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Tech 3/5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LIN (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND; VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION; WELL (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION; ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: MSFT (1W: +21.75%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +17.57%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +17.00%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple large caps (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, ORCL) display 1W vs 1M disagreement — MAJOR divergence, watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but positive on recent leaders; Tech: 15/24 positive (estimate). MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +11.24% | 1M: +18.69%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND — sector shows internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Modestly constructive; Financials: 12/20 positive (estimate). V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%) ABOVE TREND; MA (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION — look for selective strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious but not weak; Healthcare: 10/17 positive (estimate). PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: -3.95% | 1M: -3.60%) BELOW TREND; JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain neutral positioning; favor stocks showing confirmed momentum (MSFT, AMZN, ACN) and reduce exposure to names with short-term weakness and negative news flow (AAPL, QCOM, AMD). Given concentrated leadership, stay selective and monitor large-cap divergences before expanding risk.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION; QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (7/14 positive estimate) on AMZN strength. BEARISH: Utilities (3/10 positive estimate) and Real Estate (4/10 positive estimate) after steep 1W moves.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MSFT near psychological momentum zone; watch consolidation above recent breakout (1W strength sustaining ABOVE TREND). AAPL support to monitor near recent monthly pivot (CORRECTION risk if breaches). QCOM downside: failure to stabilize would confirm BELOW TREND continuation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
VTR (+80): headline positive but price diverging — VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION, bullish news not yet price-confirmed. PSA/ETN/others show strong headlines but are outside the core SP100 sample here — monitor for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): KeyBanc warning; AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligning with short-term weakness. BA (-55): cost/overrun headlines; BA (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -1.12%) RECOVERY — negative news contrasts with recent 1W bounce, monitor for reversal.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated Tech leadership (Tech 3/5 in top performers) and MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL) — watch for trend confirmation and news-driven distribution.
